design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variables are not PIRLS achievement PV scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but makes no mention of whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide information indicating that multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors were used, suggesting that school clustering was ignored.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions using internal validation methods such as bootstrapping and LASSO, indicating that only internal validation was performed.
